publishedSpecifications.label: meta description
publishedSpecifications.text: This beautiful 3-bed one-story country farmhouse has board and batten siding, exposed rafter tails, a shed dormer (it lets light into the attic) and three gables giving it great curb appeal. Inside, an open floor plan beckons. The great room will catch your eye as soon as you enter with its vaulted ceiling (17'7" to top of vault) and oversized windows to the rear porch. A pair of French doors open to the 11'-deep rear porch.In the kitchen you'll be able to entertain while you cook with an eat at bar at the island (3'10" by 9') and exemplary walk in pantry with lots of shelving and upper and lower cabinets. And when its time to unwind, retreat to your primary suite with a vaulted ceiling (15'8" to top of vault) and a large bath and closet. The bathroom has two vanities, an enclosed toilet, and both a tub and shower (46" by 72").Across the home, two bedrooms each have walk-in closets and a shared bath with two sinks.Stairs by the family entry by the garage take you to the bonus room with bathroom over the garage. This space could be used as a 4th bedroom, a play room, a study or storage and adds 344 square feet when finished.Related Plan: Get and alternate layout with 4-bedrooms on the main level with plan 51913HZ (2,258 sq. ft)
